findings.issue: P7: about 285 of the 401 whiles are word-by-word memory copies with their padding store, not converted to copy lines, even with a constant length (68). They bury the source loops of deploy (3,700 lines) and upgrade (5,900 lines).
findings.rule: 'i = 0; while i < n: mem[d + i] = mem[s + i]; i = i + 32' followed by 'if i > n: mem[d + n] = 0' is 'mem[d len n] = mem[s len n]' plus 'mem[d + n len 32] = 0' when n % 32 != 0, provided d <= s or [d, d + ceil32(n)) and [s, s + ceil32(n)) are disjoint.

findings.rule: Recognise the do-while 'body; o = o - 32; if o != 0: repeat' without peeling; a backward word copy over disjoint or downward ranges is a copy line.

notes: deploy (3,760 lines, 137 whiles) and upgrade (5,950 lines, 252 whiles) reviewed by structure. Source loops (13): migrate (OPContractsManagerV2.sol:307, while at 458), _apply (:1012), _assertValidFullConfig (:752 and the 'while True' search at :815), _assertValidUpgradeInstructions (:336 and nested :340, e.g. 'while t < _696' with the sha3 key comparison 4712), Blueprint.bytesToUint (:210), Blueprint.parseBlueprintPreamble (:76, :86, the 'while idx < Mask(2, 248, ..) >> 248' loops), JSONParserLib.parseUint Yul for (:287), LibString.indicesOf Yul for (:763, specialised to the one-byte search '.', '-', '+' as 'while True: if (mem[t] ^ 0x2e..) >> 248'), LibString.split outer and inner Yul for (:815, :823) - all shown as while; SemverComp.parse is inlined 4 times (one SemverComp.lt in each of deploy and upgrade), giving 36 'while True' instances of the library loops. Implicit loops: ~285 memory copies (P7), ~34 ABI encodings of arrays of dynamic elements ('mem[u] = -_N + t - ...' offset tables), calldata array decodes with per-element checks. P5: 6 unused identity copies (e.g. 1021, 1338). P11: implied Panic(50) bounds checks inside loops (107 Panic(50) lines). The 'if 1 > ~s: revert Panic(17)' before 'j = i + 1' is the i + 1 overflow check. No semantic error found on the paths read.
summary: Complete (no aborts) and faithful on the paths read, but dominated by solc 0.8.15 memory copies left as while loops (285 of 401 whiles), with library string-parsing loops inlined four times; errors, call arguments and returned structs are mostly raw memory.
